description: Unit tests for number parsing functions in the net namespace, specifically testing parse_number.h functions like ParseInt32, ParseInt64, ParseUint32, and ParseUint64, including edge cases such as overflow, underflow, and invalid inputs.

methods.name: CreateOverflowString
methods.description: Generates a string representing a number one greater than the maximum value of type T.

methods.name: CreateUnderflowString
methods.description: Generates a string representing a number one less than the minimum value of signed type T.

methods.name: ExpectParseIntSuccess
methods.description: Tests that parsing the input string with the specified format succeeds and yields the expected output.

methods.name: ExpectParseIntFailure
methods.description: Tests that parsing the input string with the specified format fails with the expected error.

methods.name: TestParseIntUsingFormat
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on a parse function with a specific format, including edge cases and invalid inputs.

methods.name: TestParseInt
methods.description: Runs tests on ParseInt functions for different integer types.

methods.name: TestParseUint
methods.description: Runs tests on ParseUint functions for different unsigned integer types.
